name: Thor

moves.name: Mjolnir Strike
moves.description: A close-range hammer blow that cracks pavement and sends foes through walls.

moves.name: Hammer Throw
moves.description: Hurls Mjolnir through anything in its path; it returns next round and he cannot fly until it does.

moves.name: Lightning Call
moves.description: Channels a lightning bolt through the hammer at any target he can see; hits everyone in an enclosed space.

moves.name: Storm Summon
moves.description: Spends a round raising a storm that buffs lightning and blinds and slows foes.

moves.name: Thunderclap
moves.description: Slams Mjolnir to the ground, knocking down and stunning everything nearby.

moves.name: Hammer Whirl
moves.description: Spins the hammer into a shield that deflects projectiles and absorbs energy.

moves.name: Flight Charge
moves.description: Throws the hammer and rides it into a foe or to a new position.

moves.name: Asgardian Grapple
moves.description: Seizes a foe and hurls them through the nearest piece of scenery.

moves.name: Godblast
moves.description: Channels his life force through Mjolnir into one beam; leaves him drained for days.

moves.name: Rescue
moves.description: Carries civilians or a downed ally clear by air; raises morale.

leitmotif: Wide brass-style fifths over rolling timpani-like noise channel; thunder sweeps on the noise channel when the storm comes in.
